  "description": "J-Six Group has eight locations in Lagos State, and subsidiaries in the FMCG distribution, agribusiness, agricultural, and quick service restaurant (QSR) industries. We are positioned to offer reasonable discounts on purchases, high-quality products, and customer satisfaction.

&nbsp;Job Position: Sales / Delivery Supervisor
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time&nbsp;

Management

&nbsp;

Responsibilities


	Supervise and coordinate the activities of the sales team.
	Responds warmly and promptly to inquiries via direct call lines and official WhatsApp desks, and accurately logs retail requests
	Manages and resolves customers&#39; complaints politely
	Implement corrective measures to various challenges that could arise during a sales lifecycle
	Coordinates directly with the J-Six2U sales coordinator, outlet supervisors, and dispatch team to trace delivery and check kitchen availability for items.
	Maintain and update records of customer interaction, transactions, recurring feedback, and specialized dietary preferences.
	Help the company meet monthly call-handling quotas and localized sales targets by upselling menu combos or dessert items.
	Monitor customer service standards and ensure prompt resolution of customer complaints.
	Monitor product availability and coordinate with the production team to prevent stock shortages.
	Ensure accurate documentation of sales transactions and reports.
	Coach, mentor, and develop sales personnel to improve productivity.
	Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, and compliance with company policies.


Requirements


	Possess an OND, Diploma or NCE in Administration, Marketing, Hospitality Management or related disciplines with 1 - 3 years of experience in CSR operations, Sales management and Customer service coordination.
	High emotional maturity, active listening, an empathetic disposition and the ability to maintain absolute patience under intense pressure.
	Capacity to maintain composure and coordinate dispatch operations, ability to work effectively under pressure during peak period.
	Only candidates living around Ijora axis will be considered for this role.


Salary
N80,000 Monthly.

Method of Application&nbsp;

	The WASH sector in Nigeria is committed to accelerating progress towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by ensuring equitable access to safe, inclusive, and sustainable WASH services. 	knowledge products.

	Undertake any other relevant assignment as requested by the supervisor to support the achievement of UNICEF&#39;s WASH in Institutions programme objectives.
